title: Application of Eastern Edison Company for authorization and approval by the Department of Public Utilities of (1) the issuance and sale of one or more new series of (i) its First Mortgage and collateral Trust Bonds, (ii) medium term notes, either as first mortgage bonds or unsecured notes and (iii) unsecured notes, in an aggregate principal amount not in excess of $175,000,000; (2) the issuance and sale of a new class or classes of cumulative preferrred stock in an amount not in excess of $40,000,000; and (3) exemptions from the provisions of Sections 15 and 15A of Chatper 164 of the General Laws.
